import datetime,json,os,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
run=Path(sys.argv[1]);command=json.loads(sys.argv[2]);viewer=json.loads(sys.argv[3]);root=Path(sys.argv[4])
def write(name,value):
    path=run/name;tmp=path.with_suffix(path.suffix+'.tmp');tmp.write_text(json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');os.replace(tmp,path)
def now(): return datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat()
job=dict(supervisor_pid=os.getpid(),launched_at=now(),command=command,status='running',bounded_updates=1000)
with (run/'run.log').open('a',buffering=1) as log:
    child=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=root,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,close_fds=True)
    job['child_pid']=child.pid;write('JOB.json',job)
    result=child.wait();job.update(returncode=result,finished_at=now(),status='completed' if result==0 else 'failed');write('JOB.json',job)
if result==0:
    (run/'visuals/viser').mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    with (run/'visuals/viser/server.log').open('a',buffering=1) as log:
        process=subprocess.Popen(viewer,cwd=root,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True,close_fds=True)
    write('VIEWER_LAUNCH.json',dict(launched_at=now(),pid=process.pid,command=viewer,url='http://localhost:8802/',status='preparing_after_trial',not_yet_verified_listening=True))
sys.exit(result)
